response.overview: After a violent tragedy at a local saloon leaves her orphaned and on the run, young Kid Allen sets out on her pony to fulfill her late father’s dream of getting an education. Along the way, an injury leads her into the care of a kindhearted sheepherder, sparking a romance before she pushes onward toward a university town—where she quickly discovers that fitting into a new world won't be easy.
response.title: The Love Call
